title: This Lawyer’s Options Trading Strategy Guarantees No Loss (Here’s How)
summary: Christian, a risk-averse Munich lawyer/options trader, pitches a 'no-loss-at-expiration' combo: take a butterfly/calendar/condor and replace one long-option leg with synthetic long stock (put-call parity) so the position carries a large debit earning the Fed-funds rate; if that carry exceeds the structure's loss zone, the floor lifts to >=$0 at expiry. The 'no loss' is arithmetically TRUE but trivial (textbook cost-of-carry) and only at expiration; base return is ~1-2% (sub-T-bill) on $50k-$84k/combo before fees/slippage, dies at zero rates, and the claimed 20-25%/yr secretly rests on a directional read he disclaims. Legitimate as a capital-preservation overlay, not the money machine the title implies. Write-up: strategies/no_loss_combo.md (conviction 2/5).
